users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone who can sign in, and the role that decides what they can do.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it privately; they can change it later.

users.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every session this person has, for example after a lost phone or laptop

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: A role is a set of permissions. Built-in roles are fixed; copy one to make your own.
roles.superNote: Super Admin always has every permission and cannot be changed. At least one active Super Admin must exist.
roles.builtInNote: Built-in roles cannot be edited. Copy this role to change its permissions.
roles.name: Role name
roles.pick: Choose a role to see its permissions.
roles.confirmDelete: Delete the role {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
roles.homeHint: People in this role land here after signing in. The role is given view access to it.
roles.lockHint: No menu and no other pages: they see their home dashboard and can sign out. Never applies to Super Admin.

perms.datasources:read: See data sources and their tables
perms.datasources:write: Add, update and remove data sources
perms.datasources:access: Choose which roles can use each data source

access.title: Data access
access.subtitle: Choose which roles can query each data source. Dashboards still decide what viewers see.
access.alwaysHint: This role manages data sources, so it can use all of them.
access.noQueryHint: This role cannot run queries, so access does not apply.
access.legend: "Always" roles manage data sources. Roles marked "No queries" only see data through dashboards. Changes save straight away.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Connectors and features installed on this server.
plugins.name: Name
plugins.featuresHint: These may need a licence in a later version. For now every one is on.
plugins.later: Installing third-party plugins arrives with the plugin system in a later release.

settings.title: Settings and theme
settings.subtitle: Your organisation's name, language and look.
settings.orgNameHint: Shown at the top of the menu.
settings.themeHint: Applies to dashboards and the workspace. Administration pages always keep the standard look, so a theme can never hide these controls.
settings.lowContrast: White text on this primary colour is hard to read (contrast {{ratio}}:1; at least 4.5:1 is needed). Choose a darker colour.

rules.title: Row rules
rules.lead: A row rule makes each person in a role see only their own rows: Paarvix keeps only rows where the column equals that person's attribute. It applies on the server to every dashboard, query and preview. A table without the column is refused, never shown in full. Email and department come from each user's profile; other attributes, such as reg_no, are set on the Users page.
rules.none: No row rules yet: everyone with access sees every row.
rules.columnHint: Applies to every table that has this column.
rules.attributeHint: email, department, or an attribute set on Users, such as reg_no.
rules.confirmRemove: Remove this row rule? People in {{role}} will then see every row of {{source}}.

queries.title: Queries
queries.subtitle: Ask a question of your data. Build it step by step, or write SQL.
queries.shareHint: Share with everyone who can use this data source
queries.noSources: No data sources you can query yet.
queries.sqlPreviewNote: For reading only. Paarvix builds and runs its own safe version of this query.
queries.sqlHint: One SELECT statement. Read-only: queries that change data are refused. Ctrl+Enter runs.
queries.sqlNotForSheets: SQL works with PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB sources. Use the builder for spreadsheets.
queries.editorFailed: The SQL editor could not load. You can still type SQL here.
queries.startSource: Choose a data source to begin.
queries.startTable: Choose a sheet or table to see its rows.
queries.startSql: Write a SELECT query and press Run.
queries.sourceGone: That query's data source is no longer available to you.
queries.tableGone: That query's sheet or table no longer exists.
queries.chartNeedsNumber: A chart needs at least one number column. Add a measure such as Count, or switch to the table.
queries.chartCapped: The chart shows the first {{count}} rows; the table has them all.
queries.noDashboards: You have no dashboards to edit yet.

dashboards.subtitle: Live views of your data, each shown only to the roles you choose.
dashboards.title: Dashboard name
dashboards.whoHint: People in these roles can open this dashboard. Anyone who can edit dashboards sees all of them. Viewers never need access to the data source: the server runs each panel's saved query for them.
dashboards.emptyWriter: No dashboards yet. Create one, then add panels from your saved queries.
dashboards.emptyViewer: No dashboards have been shared with you yet.
dashboards.notFound: This dashboard does not exist, or it is not shared with you.
dashboards.previewing: Previewing as {{role}}: this is exactly what people in that role see.
dashboards.confirmDelete: Delete the dashboard {{name}}? Its saved queries are kept.
dashboards.tooMany: A dashboard can have at most {{count}} panels.
dashboards.emptyEdit: Add a panel to start. Each panel shows one saved query.
dashboards.emptyView: This dashboard has no panels yet.
dashboards.makeQuery: Save a query on the Queries page first
dashboards.tooManyLabels: This query returns {{count}} separate rows, too many to chart one by one. Edit the saved query and add Summarise (for example Count by a column).
dashboards.sectionsHint: Sections group panels: tabs on a phone, headings on a laptop, one screen each on a TV.

roleHint.headline: Shown first and largest. A query that returns a series (for example Count by month) also shows the change and a trend line.
roleHint.story: The main chart of its section, at full width.
roleHint.supporting: Smaller, beside other supporting charts. On a phone they become a strip you swipe.
roleHint.detail: A table, shown last. On a phone it opens in a sheet.
roleHint.note: Plain text, for context or instructions.

account.title: Your account

account.none: No other devices are signed in.
account.loadError: Could not load your devices. Try again.
